issues: The fanfare is incorrectly encoded as an unconditional tutor for any follower plus shuffle. It should first select an enemy follower, then search your deck for a follower with cost equal to the selected follower's cost, put it into your EX area, then shuffle. Implement support for using a selected target's cost as a deck-filter cost value (for example a dynamic filter based on selected target cost) and encode the whole fanfare as a single targeted tutor sequence.

The spell is incorrectly encoded as simply draw 1. It should declare a card name, reveal the top card of your deck, then draw 2 if it has the declared name, otherwise draw 1. Implement abilities for declaring a card name and revealing/checking the top card of the deck against that declared name, then encode the conditional draw.

The triggered ability target is encoded incorrectly as only an enemy follower. It should target an enemy leader or enemy follower and deal 1 damage. Implement a target selector that can choose either enemy leader or enemy follower, then use that selector in the onAllyFollowerEnter ability.

The second activated ability is left as noop. It should be [act] [engage], bury this card: destroy each enemy follower with cost equal to the number of calamity counters this card had. Implement support for destroying all enemy followers matching a dynamic cost value based on counters on the source, then replace the noop with that effect.

The spell is left as noop. It should have each player choose a follower on their field and then transfer control of it to another player of their choice, starting with the active player. Implement support for control-changing effects on selected followers, including multiplayer choice/order handling, then replace the noop with the real effect.
